import sys
import pandas as pd

input_path = sys.argv[1]
df = pd.read_csv(input_path, sep="\t", header=0, dtype=str)
for col in ["Sample ID", "Status", "Sex", "BLM Mutation Status", "Age"]:
    if col not in df.columns:
        raise SystemExit(f"missing required column: {col}")
df["Age_numeric"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Age"], errors="coerce")
eligible = df.loc[
    df["Sex"].astype("string").str.strip().eq("M")
    & df["BLM Mutation Status"].astype("string").str.strip().eq("Carrier")
].copy()
eligible = eligible.loc[eligible["Age_numeric"].notna()]
if eligible.empty:
    raise SystemExit("no male carriers with numeric age")
max_age = eligible["Age_numeric"].max()
oldest = eligible.loc[eligible["Age_numeric"].eq(max_age)]
if len(oldest) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("oldest male carrier is not unique")
row = oldest.iloc[0]
sample_id = str(row["Sample ID"]).strip()
if sample_id.endswith(".0"):
    sample_id = sample_id[:-2]
with open("oldest.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("Sample ID\tAge\tSex\tBLM Mutation Status\n")
    out.write(f"{sample_id}\t{row['Age']}\t{row['Sex']}\t{row['BLM Mutation Status']}\n")
